source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: In your Shooting phase, once this unit has shot, choose one enemy unit that at least one of those attacks hit. Until the turn ends, attacks by your NURGLE LEGIONES DAEMONICA units that target that enemy unit may re-roll their Wound rolls.
